about: The portable Node.js the release bundles (tools/bin/node/node.exe, release-tools/make_release.js) and a source checkout downloads when it has no Node 20+ (setup/get_node.ps1, from setup\setup.bat). Official win-x64 zip of nodejs.org; zip_sha256 is the line of the release's SHASUMS256.txt; node_exe_sha256 is the node.exe inside it (release-tools/scan.js allows that binary by this hash).
license: MIT (Node.js), with the third-party licences of its bundled components in the same LICENSE file

linux_x64.about: The same Node.js for Linux: the official linux-x64 tarball of nodejs.org (glibc 2.28 or newer: every current distribution and SteamOS 3). setup-linux is its bin/node as a single executable application (release-tools/make_release.js); a source checkout without a Node 20+ downloads it (setup/get_node.sh, from setup/setup.sh). tgz_sha256 is the line of the release's SHASUMS256.txt; node_sha256 is bin/node inside it.
